name: CopyButton
description:
A Button that copies text to the clipboard, then swaps its icon for a drawn check.

  CopyButton(value: "npm install @appica/ui-react")
  CopyButton(target: "#install-command", label: "Copy command")     # an element's value / text
  CopyButton(value: url, variant: :outline, size: :sm, copied_label: "Copied!") { "Copy" }

Takes every Button prop (ghost, small and square by default). A text label swaps to `copied_label:` while copied; the accessible name and a status message change too. `icon:` replaces the resting copy glyph. Emits `appica-ui--copy-button:copy` with { value } (or `:error`), and sets data-copied for `timeout:` ms.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `CopyButton(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  CopyButton(value:, variant:, timeout:, size:, **given(label:, copied_label:))
end

examples.name: Variants
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3") do
    %i[ ghost soft outline primary_outline primary secondary ].each { |variant| CopyButton(value: variant.to_s, variant:) }
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.notes: Square icon sizes by default; give it a block for a text label (then `sm` / `md` / `lg`).
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex items-center gap-3") do
    %i[ sm md lg ].each { |size| CopyButton(value: size.to_s, variant: :outline, size:) }
  end
end

examples.name: With a label
examples.notes: A text label swaps to `copied_label:` while copied.

examples.name: Custom icon
examples.code: phlex { CopyButton(value: "https://appica.dev/ui", icon: :link, label: "Copy link", copied_label: "Link copied", variant: :outline, size: :md) }

examples.name: Copy from an element
examples.notes: `target:` copies another element's text (or an input's value).
